title: Corpus study of 'hallucinate' and cognitive verbs applied to AI systems, 2015-2026
description:
Code, data, results tables, validation samples and figures for the corpus study reported in section 3 of Matthieu Queloz, 'Familiar Words, Unfamiliar Minds: Conventionalization without Calibration in the Vocabulary of Mind'.

The study traces the word hallucinate in 8,568 arXiv abstracts and 31,866 Hacker News comments, and the subjects of five cognitive verbs in a sample of 31,123 abstracts in computational linguistics. Hacker News comment texts are not redistributed; comment IDs and derived annotations are. Code is under the MIT licence; results, figures and documentation under CC BY 4.0; arXiv metadata is CC0.
